name: paper-orchestra
description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
one_liner: A team of AI agents that turns your raw research notes and experiment logs into a polished, submission-ready academic paper draft.
buyer: A PhD student or overworked research lab PI who needs to turn experiment results into conference submissions faster.
business_use_cases: A research lab uses it to draft first-pass manuscripts from experiment logs ahead of a conference deadline, saving weeks of writing.
A science-writing agency offers 'draft your paper from your data' as a paid service for non-native-English researchers.
A university writing center licenses it to help grad students produce stronger first drafts for advisor review.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'paper-in-a-weekend' drafting service for researchers facing a deadline, priced per paper.
Build a hosted SaaS wrapper with a nicer UI and literature-database integrations, sold to labs by seat.

steal_this: Host this behind a simple upload-your-notes web form and charge grad students a flat fee per generated draft — a clear, bounded service to test this weekend.
